title: Verbs followed by Infinitive
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes qué verbos comunes en los negocios requieren ir seguidos de 'to + verbo'.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Verbos seguidos de Infinitivo

parts.visual: En inglés, cuando ponemos dos verbos juntos, el primer verbo decide la forma del segundo. Algunos verbos SIEMPRE van seguidos del infinitivo con 'to' (to + verbo).
parts.audio: In English, when we put two verbs together, the first verb decides the form of the second. Some verbs are ALWAYS followed by the infinitive with 'to'.

parts.visual: Verbos clave de negocios que usan 'to': WANT (querer), NEED (necesitar), PLAN (planear), DECIDE (decidir), HOPE (esperar/desear), AGREE (estar de acuerdo). Ejemplo: We plan to open a new branch (Planeamos abrir una nueva sucursal). He agreed to sign the contract (Él accedió a firmar).
parts.audio: Key business verbs that use 'to': Want, need, plan, decide, hope, and agree. Example: We plan to open a new branch. He agreed to sign the contract.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del verbo.

questions.question: They plan ____ a new product next year. (Lanzar).
She needs ____ the supplier right now. (Llamar).
They decided not ____ the contract. (No renovar).
I hope ____ from you soon. (Saber / Escuchar).
Does he want ____ the team? (Unirse a).
She plans ____ to New York next month. (Viajar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en infinitivo con 'to' (ej: to speak).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I want to speak to the manager.
options: I want to speak to the manager.
She wants to speak to the manager.
I need to speak to the manager.
I want to talk to the manager.
questions.correct_answer: I want to speak to the manager.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to finish the report.
options: We need to finish the report.
They need to finish the report.
We have to finish the report.
We want to finish the report.
questions.correct_answer: We need to finish the report.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They plan to launch a new product.
options: They plan to launch a new product.
We plan to launch a new product.
They want to launch a new product.
They plan to show a new product.
questions.correct_answer: They plan to launch a new product.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The CEO decided to close the office.
options: The CEO decided to close the office.
The manager decided to close the office.
The CEO decided to sell the office.
The board decided to close the office.
questions.correct_answer: The CEO decided to close the office.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I hope to see the results soon.
options: I hope to see the results soon.
I want to see the results soon.
I need to see the results soon.
We hope to see the results soon.
questions.correct_answer: I hope to see the results soon.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: He agreed to give the discount.
options: He agreed to give the discount.
She agreed to give the discount.
He wanted to give the discount.
They agreed to give the discount.
questions.correct_answer: He agreed to give the discount.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Do you want to take a break?
options: Do you want to take a break?
Do they want to take a break?
Does he want to take a break?
Do you need to take a break?
questions.correct_answer: Do you want to take a break?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We hope to meet the deadline.
options: We hope to meet the deadline.
They hope to meet the deadline.
We need to meet the deadline.
We want to meet the deadline.
questions.correct_answer: We hope to meet the deadline.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I hope to hear from you soon.
options: I hope to hear from you soon.
We hope to hear from you soon.
I want to hear from you soon.
I hope to get an email soon.
questions.correct_answer: I hope to hear from you soon.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They decided to hire a new assistant.
options: They decided to hire a new assistant.
We decided to hire a new assistant.
They plan to hire a new assistant.
